correctness.rationale: In a nonunital free algebra the degree-four ideal can only contain one extra leaf beyond a defining cubic relation. The five compatible contexts are multiplication on either side by a leaf and inserting one binary product in any of the three arguments. Bilinearity spans all instances using x,y, including repeated letters, so the 160 relations in the given 80 words are exhaustive. An independently written postfix construction recreated both exact pivot minors, −2^41 δ^9(δ+1)^3 and −2^38, and independently obtained the listed normalized annihilator vectors from reduced rows. They annihilate the symbolic or exceptional matrix with identity restriction to the proposed free columns. Thus the named words are independent for every specialization in their stated regime, and the minor bounds make them bases. The words are homogeneous in leaf counts, giving precisely the stated profiles. Degree three first quotients by antisymmetry in the last two slots for left-associated products; the other identity then solves for the symmetric part in the first two slots of the right-associated words. Each residual space has dimension two. On one generator, (xx)x and x(xx) vanish by the two identities, and the remaining balanced quartic (xx)(xx)=−(x(xx))x by the second identity also vanishes. This proves the claimed rank minimality, with no assumption about higher degrees.
residual_risks: No inference is drawn for δ=0, positive characteristic or beyond degree four. The exact symbolic minor and polynomial annihilator, rather than a generic sample, justify the full characteristic-zero parameter domain.

value.rationale: Two generators are a natural minimal test, because all one-generator quartics vanish. The new part measures how a known multilinear parameter exception is expressed in the first free algebra capable of observing it: the exceptional quotient changes the supported weights, not just the total count, and has explicit minimal-generator representatives. The precision is useful for calculations with two generators, and it cannot be read off from the known scalar arity table. The generic part alone would not justify separate value against the indexed character.
residual_risks: This is a low-degree structural invariant, not a result on all-degree growth or a new discovery of the multilinear resonance.
